subject.title: fix: copilot token cache ignores profile rotation on rate limit

question: Should maintainers require the contributor to rebase this PR onto the current SDK helper with real two-profile proof, or adopt the fix in a fresh maintainer branch?
rationale: The branch is conflicting, assigned, and proof-gated; automation cannot supply the contributor’s live Copilot credential-rotation proof or decide whether to adopt the stale external branch.

options.title: Ask for rebase and proof
options.body: Have the contributor port the cache ownership check to `src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.ts`, preserve current domain/integration guards, update tests, and add redacted real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Maintainer adopts a replacement
options.body: A maintainer can open a fresh narrow PR against current main that credits this source work if the bug is urgent or the contributor cannot refresh the branch.

options.title: Close after no response
options.body: If no rebase or proof arrives after maintainer follow-up, close this PR while keeping the canonical issue open for a replacement fix.

recommendation.title: Ask for rebase and proof
recommendation.body: Have the contributor port the cache ownership check to `src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.ts`, preserve current domain/integration guards, update tests, and add redacted real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` is the live assignee and has the strongest recent history on the active SDK helper path.
